record.context_brief: Classification of finite-dimensional irreducibles of A_q^{[2N+1]}
record.original_question: Let A_q^{[2N+1]} be the quotient of A_q obtained by imposing the polynomial relations of total degree 2N+1 in W_0 and W_1 that vanish on finite-dimensional modules. Classify the finite-dimensional irreducible modules of A_q^{[2N+1]}.

evidence.quote: From a general point of view, these relations are such that certain polynomials of total degree 2N + 1 in W0, W1 are vanishing on the module. Let A [2N+1] q denote the quotient of Aq by such relations.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{F}$ be an algebraically closed field and let $q\in\mathbb{F}^\times$ be a nonzero scalar that is not a root of unity. The $q$-Onsager algebra $O_q$ is the unital associative $\mathbb{F}$-algebra generated by two elements $W_0, W_1$ subject to the $q$-Dolan–Grady relations
$$[W_0,[W_0,[W_0,W_1]_q]_{q^{-1}}] = -(q^2-q^{-2})^2[W_0,W_1],$$
$$[W_1,[W_1,[W_1,W_0]_q]_{q^{-1}}] = -(q^2-q^{-2})^2[W_1,W_0],$$
where $[X,Y]_q := XY - qYX$. Let $A_q$ be the current algebra of $O_q$ (the algebra introduced by Baseilhac–Koizumi, presented by generators $\{W_{-k},W_{k+1},G_{k+1},\tilde{G}_{k+1}\}_{k\ge 0}$ and an explicit list of $q$-commutator relations), so that $W_0$ and $W_1$ generate a subalgebra isomorphic to $O_q$.

For a fixed positive integer $N$, on every finite-dimensional $A_q$-module there exist certain polynomial relations of total degree $2N+1$ in $W_0$ and $W_1$ which act as zero. Let $A_q^{[2N+1]}$ denote the quotient of $A_q$ by the two-sided ideal generated by all such polynomial relations of total degree $2N+1$ in $W_0,W_1$ that vanish on every finite-dimensional $A_q$-module.

Problem. Classify, up to isomorphism, all finite-dimensional irreducible $A_q^{[2N+1]}$-modules.
artifact.status_search_result: A general classification of the finite-dimensional irreducible modules for the quotient $A_q^{[2N+1]}$ of the $q$-Onsager current algebra does not appear in the literature. Subsequent work by Baseilhac and collaborators (including the more recent S_3-symmetric q-Onsager paper, 2024) develops the structure of $A_q$ and discusses related representation-theoretic constructions, but the full classification for arbitrary $N$ is not stated as completed. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: The S_3-symmetric q-Onsager algebra and its Lusztig automorphisms
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses the q-Onsager algebra O_q and its current algebra A_q (Baseilhac–Koizumi), without providing a classification of finite-dimensional irreducibles of the quotient A_q^{[2N+1]}.
status_evidence.claim: No classification of finite-dimensional irreducibles of A_q^{[2N+1]} is announced.

status_evidence.title: The q-Onsager Algebra and the Universal Askey-Wilson Algebra (SIGMA 2018)
status_evidence.snippet: Studies relations between O_q and Askey-Wilson algebra; finite-dimensional representation theory of O_q is described case by case but the quotient A_q^{[2N+1]} is not classified.
status_evidence.claim: Available structural results do not yield a classification of irreducibles of A_q^{[2N+1]}.
